fields.label: Days Before First Class
fields.description: New course and trial invoices are due this many calendar days before the first class. Zero means the class date. Existing invoices are unchanged.

fields.label: Late Booking / Mid-term Grace Days
fields.description: Calendar days after the invoice date for bookings less than the lead days before class, and mid-term enrolments. Minimum 1 day.

fields.label: Fallback Payment Due Days
fields.description: Default for manual and Workshop invoices. Course and trial invoices use the class-based settings above.

fields.label: Overdue Reminder Interval (Days)
fields.description: Days between overdue reminders for ordinary and trial invoices. Excludes payment plans. First reminder is eligible the day after the due date; maximum five attempts.
